__comment: STEP 1, and the only genuinely blocking piece. GLIMPSE2_phase consumes .bin, and the .bin files in rw-long-reads-transfer-2026-07-24/chunked_panel were split from the FULL panel. Imputing against those would put the held-out samples' own haplotypes back into the reference.
__comment_chunks: The FULL panel's chunks.tsv, reused verbatim. Columns 3 and 4 are the buffered input region and the output region, which is exactly where GLIMPSE2ChunkAndSplitPanel gets its own -- so the shard boundaries are identical by construction and the per-shard concordance still lines up with Samuel's. Deliberately NOT the chunked_panel JSON: reading that would require its n_variants_by_region field, which a panel chunked before that field existed does not have.
__comment_sites: Sites-only view of the SAME leaveout panel, for the per-shard variant counts. PostprocessBubblePanel emits one (ConcatBubbleSplitSitesOnlyLeaveOut); if it was not transferred, make one with: bcftools view -G <leaveout>.bcf --write-index=csi -Ob -o <leaveout>.sites-only.bcf
__comment_assert: Full panel is 12554, leaveout is 12064. Set this so a mis-wired path fails on one cheap task instead of producing a valid, silently circular set of .bin files.
__comment_split_args: Must match what the full panel was split with, or the .bin files are not interchangeable.
